item.title: An Update from the Anti-Cheat Team – Nov 4, 2026
item.description:
Ranked Integrity Update – Rookie Rank Exploit

We recently identified and quickly resolved an exploit that allowed some players, primarily on PlayStation 5, to enter Ranked matches as Rookie IV regardless of their actual rank.

This caused several unintended advantages, including:

  • No Ranked entry cost

  • Rookie-tier kill bonuses
